abilities.effect: Each prepared copy is one cast; consume the matching preparation and slot only after resolution. Healing effects remain guarded where exact mechanics are missing.
abilities.uses: 16 baseline copies; current live ledger overrides baseline.

abilities.effect: One fetched copy is one cast; component inventory, knowledge, retrieval state and spell mechanics must resolve first.
abilities.uses: Six named cache entries; current remaining casts require ledger confirmation.

abilities.effect: Sha’ir 3+ verified class feature: when deliberately checking, spend one round concentrating; chance is 5% per Sha’ir level (45% at level 9). It identifies qualifying genie-work only and does not reveal unrelated hidden enchantments.
abilities.uses: No expendable count recorded; action/time cost still applies.

abilities.effect: Sha’ir 5+ verified class feature: usable in a desert or lonely place. Chance is 5% per Sha’ir level (45% at level 9) that a janni is within 10 miles; on success arrival is 2–8 turns. A failed call blocks another attempt in the same 10-mile area for 48 hours. Presence does not guarantee aid.
abilities.uses: Maximum 1/day; current spent/remaining state must come from the live ledger. Missing usage state is not a free use.

abilities.effect: Sha’ir 7+ verified class feature: +2 on saves versus elemental attacks; qualifying elemental attackers suffer -2 to attack; elemental damage is reduced by 2 per die to a minimum of 1 per die. Benefits tied to Gene’s own element are not doubled until Gene’s elemental type is authoritatively set. Elemental-plane survival allowance is Sha’ir level in turns under the bound rule.
abilities.uses: Passive while applicable; no expendable count recorded.

abilities.effect: Sha’ir 9+ verified class feature: maximum once per week; 5% per Sha’ir level (45% at level 9) to call a djinni, dao, efreeti or marid under the bound class rule. A successful call arrives in 1d6 rounds; reaction/negotiation still determines assistance and the call is not control.
abilities.uses: Maximum 1/week; current spent/remaining state must come from the live ledger. Missing usage state is not a free use.

abilities.effect: Campaign familiar power: harmless ember glow illuminates a 10-foot radius for one turn. No damage, detection or ignition.
abilities.uses: 1/day; one initial unspent use only if the live ledger has not already consumed it.
abilities.cost: Uses Snogard’s magical action for the round; Gene must be present; explicit player permission.

abilities.effect: Campaign familiar power: +2 to Snogard’s next saving throw against poison within one turn, then ends. Does not cure existing poison; no stacking with another magical poison-save bonus.
abilities.uses: 1/day; one initial unspent use only if the live ledger has not already consumed it.
abilities.cost: Uses Snogard’s magical action for the round; Sekhem must be within 10 feet; explicit player permission.

familiars.name: Gene
familiars.kind: Elemental gen familiar and long-time friend
familiars.personality: Loyal, alert and proud of being addressed as Genie as an honorific.
familiars.magic: Fetch eligible wizard spells/components; recognize genie-work only through bound rules. Emberlight is a limited campaign power.
familiars.limits: One retrieval at a time; no casting while away; one fetched copy, consumed once. Retrieval takes 1d6 + spell level rounds for eligible native wizard spells. Foreign/priest fetching remains unavailable without exact rules.
familiars.actions: Watch rear/flanks from the hip pouch, warn from actual observations, ask before a retrieval or exposure to danger.
familiars.casts: Does not add independent Fireballs or replenish priest slots.
familiars.remaining: Location, health, current retrieval and fetched uses come from live state.

familiars.name: Sekhem
familiars.personality: Patient, watchful, attentive to vibrations and narrow passages.
familiars.magic: Supports the magical partnership through scouting and warnings; no independent spells or supernatural senses recorded. Serpent Ward is a limited campaign power.
familiars.limits: Sight/access/animal movement and exposure apply. Exact poison, combat, magical link and communication limits need definition.
familiars.actions: Scout reachable tight spaces after an explicit command; return observations without revealing hidden contents from the story database.
familiars.casts: Serpent Ward: maximum 1/day; shares Snogard’s magical action budget
familiars.remaining: Location, health and action availability come from live state.

personality: A deliberate elemental scholar and healer; magic is a responsibility to companions and the desert. Gene is a trusted friend, never a disposable resource; Sekhem is a patient scout.
actions: Offer protective, healing, sand and stone solutions before destructive magic. Ask the player before Snogard speaks, casts, sends a familiar or spends anything.
character_knowledge: Knows own listed equipment, verified class access, current recorded preparations/cache identities, and familiar limits. Live resource counters control remaining uses. No hidden tomb, monster or item secrets are granted.
racial_magic: Drow ancestry does not grant unrecorded innate spells; racial mechanics remain undefined.
